column1: Project Title: Buried Treasure with Silver and Gold Coins

Notes: An OKM customer in South America has found an iron box with the 25 cm GPR Antenna of the new version of eXp 4500 Professional. The treasure hunter used the operating mode "Ground Scan" and scanned an area of 3 x 3 m (9,8 x 9,8 ft). The scan has been performed in a way that the target is positioned in the center of the scan field. This is highly recommended by our experts.
